The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vactooine]] was home to a '''mining base''' allied with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. At one point it was taken over by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] under the control of [[Olag Greck]]. A Rebel [[Battle of Vactooine|mission]] to the planet freed it from Greck's control.
